subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**vicious**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses how the melting of the Arctic and greenhouse gas emissions create a loop that exacerbates global warming.
 
• The suitable word should describe a loop that intensifies or worsens the situation.
 
• "**Vicious**" is appropriate as it denotes something severe and harmful, often used to describe cycles that worsen over time.
